chunks.title: blockdiag: Structure
chunks.text:
Wrap in `blockdiag { ... }`. Edges: `A -> B -> C;`. Statements end with `;`.
Node labels: `A [label = "Load Balancer"];`. Options: `orientation = portrait;`
(default is landscape, left to right), `default_shape = roundedbox;`, `span_width = 64;`.

chunks.title: blockdiag: Node and edge attributes
chunks.text:
Shapes: `box`, `roundedbox`, `diamond`, `ellipse`, `note`, `cloud`, `mail`, `beginpoint`,
`endpoint`, `actor`, `flowchart.database`, `flowchart.condition`, `flowchart.terminator`,
`flowchart.input`. Example: `db [shape = flowchart.database];`. Colors: `color = "#ccddee"`.
Edge label: `A -> B [label = "yes"];`, styles `style = dashed`, `dir = none` or `both`.

chunks.title: blockdiag: Groups
chunks.text:
`group { label = "Backend"; color = "#77ff77"; api; worker; }` draws a box around nodes.
A node belongs to one group only.

chunks.title: blockdiag: Example: request flow
blockdiag: Common mistakes
chunks.text:
Missing outer `blockdiag {}`, missing `;`, using `-->` (use `->`), Mermaid brackets like
`A[Text]` (use `A [label = "Text"]`), node names with spaces (use an id plus a label),
putting one node in two groups.

chunks.title: C4-PlantUML: Structure
chunks.text:
PlantUML with the C4 library. Start with `@startuml`, include a level:
`!include C4_Context.puml`, `!include C4_Container.puml` or `!include C4_Component.puml`
(Container includes Context; Component includes Container). End with `@enduml`.
Optionally add `LAYOUT_LEFT_RIGHT()` or `LAYOUT_TOP_DOWN()` and `title ...`.

chunks.title: C4-PlantUML: Elements
chunks.text:
`Person(alias, "Label", "Description")`, `Person_Ext(...)`, `System(alias, "Label", "Description")`,
`System_Ext(...)`, `Container(alias, "Label", "Technology", "Description")`,
`ContainerDb(...)`, `ContainerQueue(...)`, `Component(alias, "Label", "Technology", "Description")`.
Boundaries: `System_Boundary(alias, "Label") { ... }`, `Container_Boundary(...) { ... }`,
`Enterprise_Boundary(...) { ... }`. Aliases must be simple ids without spaces or dashes.

chunks.title: C4-PlantUML: Relationships
chunks.text:
`Rel(from, to, "Label", "Technology")`, directional variants `Rel_D`, `Rel_U`, `Rel_L`, `Rel_R`,
`BiRel(a, b, "Label")`. Both ends must be existing aliases. `SHOW_LEGEND()` adds a legend.

chunks.title: C4-PlantUML: Example: container diagram
chunks.text:
```c4plantuml
@startuml
!include C4_Container.puml
title Online shop - containers
Person(customer, "Customer", "Buys products")
System_Boundary(shop, "Online Shop") {
  Container(web, "Web App", "React", "Storefront UI")
  Container(api, "API", "Node.js", "Business logic")
  ContainerDb(db, "Database", "PostgreSQL", "Orders and products")
  ContainerQueue(queue, "Queue", "RabbitMQ", "Order events")
}
System_Ext(pay, "Payment Provider", "Card payments")
Rel(customer, web, "Uses", "HTTPS")
Rel(web, api, "Calls", "JSON/HTTPS")
Rel(api, db, "Reads/writes", "SQL")
Rel(api, queue, "Publishes")
Rel(api, pay, "Charges", "HTTPS")
@enduml
```

chunks.title: C4-PlantUML: Common mistakes
chunks.text:
Including the library from a URL (Kroki has it built in: `!include C4_Container.puml`),
using `Container` without including C4_Container, aliases with spaces or dashes, missing
quotes around labels, `Rel` to an alias that was never defined, missing `}` for boundaries.

chunks.title: D2: Structure
chunks.text:
Shapes are created by naming them: `server`. Labels: `server: API Server`. Connections:
`a -> b`, `a <- b`, `a <-> b`, `a -- b`, with labels `a -> b: calls`. Comments start with `#`.
`direction: right` at top level changes layout. No semicolons needed, no wrapping block.

chunks.title: D2: Shapes and styles
chunks.text:
Set a shape with a block: `db: Orders DB { shape: cylinder }`. Shapes: `rectangle`, `square`,
`circle`, `oval`, `diamond`, `cylinder`, `queue`, `person`, `cloud`, `hexagon`, `page`,
`package`, `sql_table`, `class`. Style: `server.style.fill: "#f0f0f0"`.

chunks.title: D2: Containers for architecture diagrams
chunks.text:
Nest shapes inside a container: `backend: { api; worker }`. Refer to nested shapes with dots:
`client -> backend.api`. Containers can have labels: `backend: Backend Services { ... }`.

```d2
direction: right
user: User { shape: person }
backend: Backend {
  api: API Server
  worker: Worker
}
db: PostgreSQL { shape: cylinder }
queue: Jobs { shape: queue }
user -> backend.api: HTTPS
backend.api -> db: SQL
backend.api -> queue: enqueue
queue -> backend.worker: consume
backend.worker -> db: update
```

chunks.title: D2: ER diagrams with sql_table
D2: Flowcharts and common mistakes
chunks.text:
Decisions use `shape: diamond`; label branches on the edges: `check -> save: yes`.
Common mistakes: using `-->` (D2 uses `->`), Mermaid or PlantUML headers, unbalanced braces,
keys with spaces that are not quoted (`"web app"` or use `web: Web App`), and reserved keywords
(`shape`, `style`, `label`, `direction`) used as shape names.

chunks.title: ERD (erd tool): Structure
chunks.text:
Entities are written as `[name]` on their own line, followed by one attribute per line.
Attribute prefixes: `*` primary key, `+` foreign key, `*+` both. Plain line = normal attribute.
Leave a blank line between entities. Relationships come after the entities.

chunks.title: ERD (erd tool): Relationships and cardinality
chunks.text:
Format: `entity1 C1--C2 entity2`, where each cardinality is `?` (0 or 1), `1` (exactly 1),
`*` (0 or more), `+` (1 or more). Examples: `customer 1--* order`, `order *--1 customer`,
`student *--* course`. Entity names in relationships must match the `[name]` exactly
(case sensitive). Write no label after a relationship.

chunks.title: ERD (erd tool): Optional styling
chunks.text:
A title line `title {label: "Shop schema"}` can come first. Entity options:
`[customer] {bgcolor: "#d0e0d0"}`. Keep names simple (letters, digits, underscore).

chunks.title: ERD (erd tool): Example: shop schema
chunks.text:
```erd
[customer]
*customer_id
name
email

[order]
*order_id
+customer_id
order_date

[product]
*product_id
title
price

[order_item]
*+order_id
*+product_id
quantity

customer 1--* order
order 1--+ order_item
product 1--* order_item
```

chunks.title: ERD (erd tool): Common mistakes
chunks.text:
Using Mermaid syntax (`||--o{`), adding labels after relationships, mismatched case between
entity and relationship names, writing `PK`/`FK` words instead of `*`/`+`, adding types like
`int id` (write just the column name), missing blank line between entities.

chunks.title: Graphviz (DOT): Structure
chunks.text:
`digraph G { ... }` for directed graphs (edges `->`), `graph G { ... }` for undirected (edges `--`).
Statements end with `;`. Global settings: `rankdir=LR;` (left to right) or `TB`,
`node [shape=box, style=rounded];`, `edge [fontsize=10];`.
IDs with spaces or symbols must be quoted: `"API Gateway"`.

chunks.title: Graphviz (DOT): Nodes and edges
chunks.text:
Node with attributes: `db [label="Orders DB", shape=cylinder];`. Shapes: `box`, `ellipse`,
`diamond` (decision), `cylinder` (database), `oval`, `circle`, `doublecircle`, `note`,
`component`, `folder`. Edges with labels: `a -> b [label="yes"];`. Chains: `a -> b -> c;`.
Styles: `style=dashed`, `color=red`.

chunks.title: Graphviz (DOT): Clusters for architecture diagrams
Graphviz (DOT): Flowchart pattern
Graphviz (DOT): Common mistakes
chunks.text:
Using `->` inside `graph` (must be `--`), unquoted labels with spaces, missing closing `}`,
`subgraph` names without the `cluster` prefix (no box is drawn), HTML labels need `<...>`
instead of quotes.

chunks.title: Mermaid: Structure and diagram type
chunks.text:
The first line must name the diagram type: `flowchart TD` (or `graph TD`), `flowchart LR`,
`sequenceDiagram`, `classDiagram`, `erDiagram`, `stateDiagram-v2`, `gantt`, `pie`.
One diagram per code block. No HTML. Indentation is free but keep it consistent.

chunks.title: Mermaid: Flowchart nodes and edges
chunks.text:
Node id then shape: `A[Box]`, `B(Rounded)`, `C{Decision}`, `D[(Database)]`, `E((Circle))`.
Edges: `A --> B`, labelled `A -->|Yes| B` or `A -- Yes --> B`, dotted `A -.-> B`.
Group with `subgraph Title` ... `end`. Node ids must not contain spaces; put text in the label.
Quote labels that contain parentheses or special characters: `A["Save (draft)"]`.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  start([Start]) --> input[Enter order]
  input --> check{Stock available?}
  check -->|Yes| pay[Take payment]
  check -->|No| notify[Notify customer]
  pay --> ship[Ship order]
  ship --> done([End])
  notify --> done
```

chunks.title: Mermaid: Sequence diagram
chunks.text:
Declare `participant` or `actor` first. Sync message `A->>B: text`, reply `B-->>A: text`.
Use `activate`/`deactivate`, `Note over A,B: text`, and blocks `alt` / `else` / `end`,
`loop` / `end`, `opt` / `end`.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  actor User
  participant App
  participant Auth
  User->>App: Submit login
  App->>Auth: Verify credentials
  alt valid
    Auth-->>App: Token
    App-->>User: Show dashboard
  else invalid
    Auth-->>App: Error
    App-->>User: Show error
  end
```

chunks.title: Mermaid: Class diagram
chunks.text:
`class Name { +Type field  +method() Type }`. Relations: inheritance `Animal <|-- Dog`,
composition `Car *-- Engine`, aggregation `Team o-- Player`, association `A --> B`,
dependency `A ..> B`. Cardinality: `Customer "1" --> "*" Order : places`.

```mermaid
classDiagram
  class Animal {
    +String name
    +speak() String
  }
  class Dog {
    +fetch() void
  }
  Animal <|-- Dog
  Owner "1" --> "*" Animal : owns
```

chunks.title: Mermaid: ER diagram
chunks.text:
`erDiagram` then relationships `CUSTOMER ||--o{ ORDER : places`. Cardinality markers:
`||` exactly one, `o|` zero or one, `}o` / `o{` zero or more, `}|` / `|{` one or more.
The label after `:` is required. Attributes go in a block: type then name, then optional
`PK`, `FK`, `UK`. Entity names should not contain spaces.

```mermaid
erDiagram
  CUSTOMER ||--o{ ORDER : places
  ORDER ||--|{ ORDER_ITEM : contains
  PRODUCT ||--o{ ORDER_ITEM : "ordered in"
  CUSTOMER {
    int id PK
    string email
  }
  ORDER {
    int id PK
    int customer_id FK
    date created_at
  }
  ORDER_ITEM {
    int order_id FK
    int product_id FK
    int quantity
  }
  PRODUCT {
    int id PK
    string name
  }
```

chunks.title: Mermaid: State diagram and common mistakes
chunks.text:
`stateDiagram-v2`, start/end is `[*]`, transitions `Idle --> Running : start`. Composite states:
`state Running { ... }`. Common mistakes: missing type line, spaces in ids, using `->` instead of
`-->` in flowcharts, missing `end` for `subgraph`/`alt`/`loop`, missing `:` label in erDiagram.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Idle
  Idle --> Running : start
  Running --> Paused : pause
  Paused --> Running : resume
  Running --> [*] : stop
```

chunks.title: nomnoml: Structure
chunks.text:
Everything is a box in square brackets: `[Customer]`. Compartments are split by `|`:
`[Customer|name: string; email: string|login(); logout()]` (name | fields | methods);
items in one compartment are separated by `;`. Directives start with `#`:
`#direction: right`, `#spacing: 40`, `#fill: #eee8d5`.

chunks.title: nomnoml: Relations
chunks.text:
`[A]-[B]` association, `[A]->[B]` directed association, `[A]-->[B]` dependency,
`[Child]-:>[Parent]` generalization (inheritance, arrow points to the parent),
`[Class]--:>[Interface]` implementation, `[Whole]+->[Part]` composition,
`[Whole]o->[Part]` aggregation. Labels and multiplicity at the ends:
`[Customer] 1 - * [Order]` or `[A] owns -> [B]`.

chunks.title: nomnoml: Classifiers and state diagrams
chunks.text:
Prefix with a tag: `[<abstract> Shape]`, `[<interface> Payable]`, `[<actor> User]`,
`[<database> DB]`, `[<package> Billing|[Invoice]]` (nested), `[<state> Idle]`,
`[<choice> ok?]`, `[<start> s]`, `[<end> e]`, `[<note> text]`.

chunks.title: nomnoml: Example: class diagram
chunks.text:
```nomnoml
#direction: down
[<abstract> Vehicle|wheels: int|move()]
[Car|seats: int|honk()]
[Truck|load: float|unload()]
[Engine|power: int]
[Driver|name: string]
[Car]-:>[Vehicle]
[Truck]-:>[Vehicle]
[Vehicle]+->[Engine]
[Driver] 1 - 0..* [Vehicle]
```

chunks.title: nomnoml: Common mistakes
chunks.text:
Missing brackets around names, `:` between compartments instead of `|`, `,` instead of `;`
inside a compartment, PlantUML arrows like `<|--`, `{}` class bodies. Relations must use
names written exactly like the box names (a typo creates a new box).

chunks.title: packetdiag: Structure
chunks.text:
Wrap in `packetdiag { ... }`. Each field is `start-end: Label;` using bit positions,
or `bit: Label;` for a single bit. Options: `colwidth = 32;` bits per row, `node_height = 72;`,
`default_fontsize = 12;`. List fields in order without gaps or overlaps.

chunks.title: packetdiag: Field attributes
chunks.text:
`0-15: Source Port [color = "#ddeeff"];`, `[rotate = 270]` for narrow one-bit labels.
Instead of a range, `* Checksum [len = 16];` continues from the last bit.

chunks.title: packetdiag: Example: UDP header
packetdiag: Common mistakes
chunks.text:
Overlapping ranges, gaps between fields, missing `;`, ranges larger than the header,
labels with special characters like `(` or `,` without quotes.

chunks.title: PlantUML: Structure
chunks.text:
Every diagram is wrapped in `@startuml` and `@enduml`. The diagram type is detected from the
content (sequence, class, activity, state, use case, component). Use `title Text` for a title,
`left to right direction` to change layout. Quote names with spaces: `participant "Web App" as web`.

chunks.title: PlantUML: Sequence diagram
chunks.text:
Participants: `actor`, `participant`, `database`, `queue`, `boundary`, `control`, `entity`.
Messages: `A -> B : text` (sync), `A --> B : text` (reply), `A ->> B : text` (async).
Groups: `alt cond` / `else other` / `end`, `loop text` / `end`, `opt`, `par`.
Notes: `note right of A : text`. `activate A` / `deactivate A` show lifelines.

```plantuml
@startuml
actor Customer
participant "Web Shop" as shop
database "Orders DB" as db
Customer -> shop : Place order
activate shop
shop -> db : INSERT order
db --> shop : order id
shop --> Customer : Confirmation
deactivate shop
@enduml
```

chunks.title: PlantUML: Class diagram
PlantUML: Activity and state diagrams
PlantUML: Use case, component and ER-style diagrams
PlantUML: Common mistakes
chunks.text:
Missing `@startuml`/`@enduml`; mixing old and new activity syntax; forgetting `;` after
`:Action`; unbalanced `if/endif`, `alt/end`; Mermaid reply arrows like `-->>`; spaces in
alias names without quotes.

chunks.title: seqdiag: Structure
chunks.text:
Wrap everything in `seqdiag { ... }`. Each statement ends with `;`. Participants are created
the first time they are used; to fix the order, list them first: `browser; webserver; database;`.
Labels on participants: `browser [label = "Web Browser"];`.

chunks.title: seqdiag: Messages
chunks.text:
`A -> B [label = "request"];` call, `A <-- B [label = "response"];` reply (dashed, written
from the caller side), `A ->> B` async, `A => B [label = "call", return = "result"];` call with
automatic return, nested calls: `A => B [label = "x"] { B => C [label = "y"]; }`.
Self message: `A -> A [label = "check"];`. Notes: `[label = "x", note = "comment"]`.

chunks.title: seqdiag: Separators and options
chunks.text:
Separators: `=== Section title ===` and delay `... wait ...`. Options at the top:
`edge_length = 200;`, `span_height = 15;`, `activation = none;`, `autonumber = True;`.

chunks.title: seqdiag: Example: login sequence
seqdiag: Common mistakes
chunks.text:
Missing outer `seqdiag {}`, missing `;`, Mermaid/PlantUML syntax like `A->>B: text`,
labels without quotes, writing replies as `B --> A` instead of `A <-- B`,
participant names with spaces (use an id and a `label`).

chunks.title: Structurizr DSL: Structure
chunks.text:
`workspace { model { ... } views { ... } }`. The model defines people, software systems,
containers and relationships; views say what to draw. Kroki renders the first view.
Identifiers are assigned with `=`: `user = person "User"`. Strings use double quotes.

chunks.title: Structurizr DSL: Model elements
chunks.text:
`name = person "Name" "Description"`,
`name = softwareSystem "Name" "Description" { ... }`,
inside a system: `web = container "Web App" "Description" "Technology"`,
inside a container: `ctrl = component "Controller" "Description" "Technology"`.
Tags are the next string: `db = container "Database" "Stores data" "PostgreSQL" "Database"`.

chunks.title: Structurizr DSL: Relationships
chunks.text:
`source -> destination "Description" "Technology"`. Both ends must be identifiers defined
earlier (nested identifiers are in scope). Put relationships inside `model`, after the elements.

chunks.title: Structurizr DSL: Views and styles
chunks.text:
`systemContext <system> { include * autoLayout }`, `container <system> { include * autoLayout lr }`,
`component <container> { include * autoLayout }`.
Styles: `styles { element "Database" { shape Cylinder } element "Person" { shape Person } }`.
Do not use `theme` URLs (they need network access); keep styles inline.

chunks.title: Structurizr DSL: Example: container view
Structurizr DSL: Common mistakes
chunks.text:
Missing `views` (nothing to render), relationships to undefined identifiers, identifiers with
dashes or spaces, single quotes, `container` outside a `softwareSystem` block,
`theme default` (needs network), `!include` of remote files.

chunks.title: Symbolator: Structure
chunks.text:
Symbolator draws a component symbol from a VHDL entity (or Verilog module) declaration.
Only the interface matters: write the `entity ... is port (...); end entity;` part.
Put `library ieee; use ieee.std_logic_1164.all;` before the entity.

chunks.title: Symbolator: Ports and sections
chunks.text:
`port ( name : direction type; ... );` with directions `in`, `out`, `inout`. The last port has
no trailing `;`. Vectors: `std_logic_vector(7 downto 0)`. Generics go before ports:
`generic ( WIDTH : integer := 8 );`. Comments starting with `--#` create section labels in the
symbol, e.g. `--# {{clocks|}}` or `--# {{data|Data ports}}`.

chunks.title: Symbolator: Example: counter
Symbolator: Common mistakes
chunks.text:
Writing an architecture body (not needed), a trailing `;` after the last port, missing
`end entity;`, missing library lines, mixing Verilog and VHDL in one file.

chunks.title: TikZ: Structure
chunks.text:
Kroki compiles a full LaTeX document. Use
`\documentclass[tikz,border=5pt]{standalone}`, load libraries with
`\usetikzlibrary{positioning,arrows.meta,shapes.geometric}`, then
`\begin{document}`, `\begin{tikzpicture} ... \end{tikzpicture}`, `\end{document}`.

chunks.title: TikZ: Nodes and edges
chunks.text:
`\node[draw, rectangle] (a) {Text};` and place relative: `\node[draw, right=2cm of a] (b) {B};`
(needs `positioning`). Lines: `\draw[->] (a) -- (b);`, labelled:
`\draw[->] (a) -- node[above] {yes} (b);`.
Styles: `\tikzset{box/.style={draw, rounded corners, minimum width=2.5cm}}`.
Shapes from `shapes.geometric`: `diamond`, `ellipse`, `trapezium`, `cylinder`.

chunks.title: TikZ: Example: flowchart
TikZ: Common mistakes
chunks.text:
Missing `\documentclass` or `\begin{document}`, using `right=of` without the `positioning`
library, missing `;` at the end of each `\node` or `\draw`, unescaped `&`, `%`, `_` in labels,
packages that are not installed on the server.

chunks.title: Vega-Lite: Structure
chunks.text:
A single JSON object with `"$schema": "https://vega.github.io/schema/vega-lite/v5.json"`,
`"description"`, `"data"`, `"mark"` and `"encoding"`. It must be strict JSON: double quotes,
no comments, no trailing commas. Inline data: `"data": {"values": [{"a": "A", "b": 28}]}`.

chunks.title: Vega-Lite: Marks and encodings
chunks.text:
Marks: `bar`, `line`, `point`, `area`, `arc` (pie), `rect` (heatmap), `tick`, `rule`, `text`.
Encoding channels: `x`, `y`, `color`, `size`, `theta` (for arc), `tooltip`. Each needs a
`"field"` and a `"type"`: `quantitative`, `nominal`, `ordinal`, `temporal`.
Aggregates: `{"aggregate": "sum", "field": "sales", "type": "quantitative"}`.

chunks.title: Vega-Lite: Example: bar chart
Vega-Lite: Pie charts, layers and common mistakes
chunks.text:
Pie: `"mark": {"type": "arc"}` with `"theta": {"field": "value", "type": "quantitative"}` and
`"color": {"field": "category", "type": "nominal"}`. Layers: `"layer": [{...}, {...}]` sharing data.
Common mistakes: JavaScript object syntax instead of JSON, missing `type` in encodings,
external data URLs, Vega (not Lite) keys like `"marks"` or `"signals"`.

chunks.title: WaveDrom: Structure
chunks.text:
A JSON-like object with a `signal` array: `{ signal: [ { name: "clk", wave: "p...." } ] }`.
Keys may be unquoted (WaveJSON). Each lane has a `name` and a `wave`; one wave character per
clock period. Optional `head: { text: "Title" }`, `foot`, `config: { hscale: 2 }`.

chunks.title: WaveDrom: Wave characters
chunks.text:
`p`/`n` clock with positive/negative edge, `P`/`N` with arrow, `0`/`1` low/high,
`x` unknown, `z` high impedance, `.` repeat previous, `=` or `2`..`9` data value (labels from
`data: ["a", "b"]`), `u`/`d` pull up/down, `|` gap. Example: `wave: "x.=.=x", data: ["A", "B"]`.

chunks.title: WaveDrom: Groups and spacing
chunks.text:
Group lanes with nested arrays: `["Bus", {name: "addr", wave: "x=.x"}, {name: "data", wave: "x.=x"}]`.
An empty object `{}` adds a spacer row. Keep all lanes the same length.

chunks.title: WaveDrom: Example: read cycle
WaveDrom: Common mistakes
chunks.text:
Different wave lengths, fewer data labels than `=` segments, wave values like `high`,
trailing commas, wrapping the object in JavaScript (`var x = ...`).
